conflict_register.resolution: Exclude schelling_credible_commitment from universality-class PASS counts and submission claims; retain the synthetic response-model experiment and WTO observational rejection as bounded method results only.

claims.exact_wording: The legacy internal taxonomy records a mixture of PASS, REJECT, INCONCLUSIVE, SPLIT, and MERGE decisions; those labels are internal pipeline verdicts rather than externally replicated universality findings.
claims.scope: Internal B1 taxonomy and four synthetic null controls only; the manuscript counts remain submission-blocked where they conflict with the current taxonomy or depend on synthetic anchors.
claims.environment: Repository Python environment; internal taxonomy review plus synthetic controls
claims.result_figure_table: B1_final_summary.md and null_results.json; manuscript Abstract and Contributions 2-3
claims.provenance: Internal critic/ensemble taxonomy and synthetic null generators.
claims.independence: No recorded external taxonomy review or independent reproduction.
caveats: Synthetic null rejection is not evidence of real-domain external validity.
Schelling is rejected as a universality class by B1 and must not be included in PASS counts.

claims.exact_wording: In the four recorded literature anchors, Layer 1 aggregation-size exponents fall within the preregistered [1.7, 3.5] band; the anchors span biology and physical chemistry.
claims.scope: Four literature-anchored constants recorded in results.json; this is not a universal law over all matter and the older anchors include pre-Clauset log-log fits.
claims.environment: Repository Python environment; literature constants and inherited Allen Brain TBI fits
claims.result_figure_table: results.json: layer1_per_plaque and layer2_population; manuscript Abstract and Contribution 5
claims.provenance: Literature-anchored constants plus an inherited real-data cross-section; not raw remeasurement of every source paper.
claims.independence: Internal pipeline run; no independent external replication or external reviewer verdict recorded.
caveats: Three Layer 1 anchors use literature-reported or pre-Clauset fits.
The evidence supports this four-anchor sample, not universality over all matter.

claims.exact_wording: The selected synthetic threshold-tobit sub-run supports only a partial-anchor-fit verdict, not a real-world confirmation of Schelling credible commitment.

claims.exact_wording: In the manually coded 23-dispute WTO sample, the fitted slope is negative and its recorded 95% bootstrap interval excludes zero, contradicting the preregistered positive-slope observational prediction.
claims.scope: The 23 disputes reaching the retaliation-request stage in the recorded Horn-Mavroidis-derived sample; this rejects the stated observational prediction, not Schelling theory generally.
claims.environment: Repository Python environment; manually coded WTO outcomes
claims.seed: bootstrap implementation recorded by the analysis script
claims.result_figure_table: results_real_wto.json fit.beta_probit and fit.k_ci95; manuscript Abstract and Contribution 6
claims.provenance: Horn-Mavroidis-derived dispute selection plus repository manual outcome coding.
claims.independence: Internal coding and analysis; manual coding has not received recorded independent double-coding.
caveats: Observational selection prevents a general causal conclusion.
Policy-cluster bootstrap preserves the negative sign but has an extreme separation tail; coefficient magnitude is unstable.
The result is based on a small manually coded selected sample and requires independent double-coding before any stronger claim.
